dashboard.label: TA-psi Metrics
dashboard.description: Index-time metrics over index=metrics (sourcetype psi:metrics); series prefixed 'psi.'.

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-psi requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-psi", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-psi/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click a row to configure the key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M") | table host status last_reported note
| mstats avg("psi.*_some_avg10") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "psi.*_some_avg10"
| mstats avg("psi.*_some_avg60") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "psi.*_some_avg60"
| mstats avg("psi.*_full_avg10") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "psi.*_full_avg10"

panel.title: PSI uninterruptible time (ms cumulative) per resource

search.query: | mstats avg("psi.*_total_ms") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "psi.*_total_ms"
